entities.summary: GP Racing, formerly F1 Racing, was a monthly magazine focused on Formula One racing published from March 1996 to December 2024. In 2025, the publication was merged with its sister brand Autosport to create a newly combined monthly publication; which effectively ended the GP Racing magazine after 28 years in circulation.
